reference.title: Calibration of the ruby pressure gauge to 800 kbar under quasi-hydrostatic conditions

methods.source_location: Experimental method, page 1761: ruby spheres were internal diffraction pressure standards (Mao et al. 1986)

recalculation.notes: The exact Mao et al. ruby scale is executable and every source-scale pressure is bundled. The monotonic calibration can be inverted to reconstruct wavelength ratios; raw ruby wavelengths are not printed.

assessment.basis: Every compared free coefficient meets both the recorded combined-two-sigma comparison and parameter-specific numerical similarity screen. Error conventions and fit qualifications remain applicable.

scientific_validation.note: Validated against the author-uploaded copy of the final American Mineralogist article, with the complete printed Table 1 transcribed. LitCurate was used only for discovery.

primary_source_check.source_version: author-uploaded copy of the final published American Mineralogist pages
primary_source_check.finding: The source defines a standard zero-pressure BM3 fit for the Pbnm conventional-cell volume, reports all three coefficients with standard deviations, excludes decompression data, and identifies the Mao et al. (1986) ruby scale. No separate supplement or machine-readable data attachment was located.

primary_data_check.finding: All 11 printed P-a-b-c-V rows and their standard deviations are bundled; the decompression row remains present and is explicitly excluded from the published fit.

independent_numerical_check.method: Direct evaluation of the standard BM3 equation from the printed coefficients against the ten source compression rows.

independent_refit.method: Independent iteratively reweighted errors-in-variables approximation using standard BM3 and the printed pressure and volume standard deviations; this diagnostic is not substituted for the published record.

unresolved_issues: The article does not print the numerical K0-K' covariance matrix; only 1-sigma-equivalent confidence ellipses are plotted.
The article names EosFit52 but does not print its exact BM3 objective or weighting configuration; the independent errors-in-variables diagnostic is therefore not claimed as an exact reconstruction.
The experimental temperature is reported only as room temperature, without a numerical kelvin value.

parameter_provenance.determination_method: Measurements or their experimental reduction determine this EOS; source: Abstract; Experimental method; Results; Table 1; Table 2; Figures 1-2 and captions.
parameter_provenance.equation: Results, page 1761: third-order Birch-Murnaghan EOS fitted with EosFit52; Figure 2 explicitly defines the standard Eulerian finite strain fE=[(V0/V)^(2/3)-1]/2 and normalized stress FE=P/[3 fE (1+2 fE)^(5/2)].
parameter_provenance.V0: Abstract and Table 2: 229.463(8) A^3 conventional Pbnm cell; described with K0 and K' as a refined parameter and not marked fixed.
parameter_provenance.reference_pressure: The BM3 reference state is zero pressure; Table 1 reports the ambient observation as 0.00010(1) GPa.
parameter_provenance.reference_temperature: Experimental method: room temperature; the source does not report a numerical kelvin value.
parameter_provenance.fit_selection: Results, page 1761: the decompression data were not considered during EOS fitting; the ten compression rows through 7.79 GPa are selected.
parameter_provenance.uncertainties: Tables 1-2 note that parenthetical values are standard deviations; Figure 2 describes 1-sigma-equivalent K0-K' confidence ellipses but publishes no numerical covariance matrix.

source_lineage.role: published EOS equation, coefficients, uncertainties, observations, range, and pressure calibration
source_lineage.citation: Boffa Ballaran et al. (2007), American Mineralogist 92, 1760-1763

source_lineage.role: diffraction-ready Pbnm structure from the same synthesis run
source_lineage.citation: Boffa Ballaran et al. (2025), official supplement ba8x2.cif

superseded_record_text.notes: This record is limited to the Pbnm CaIrO3 perovskite polymorph and must not be used for the Cmcm post-perovskite. V0 is the four-formula-unit conventional-cell volume. The source describes V0, K0, and K' together as refined parameters and marks none fixed, so fixed_parameters is empty. The printed standard deviations are retained without conversion to a confidence interval, and numerical covariance is absent rather than assumed zero.
validity_notes: The interval is the marginal range of the included room-temperature compression observations, not a phase-stability claim.
The source gives only 'room temperature', without a numerical temperature in kelvin; this is an isothermal record with no thermal correction.
The authors caution that extrapolation beyond 15-20 GPa reverses the relative compressibilities of the two low-pressure fits.
